items.title: 67520_George Handy oral history interview
items.q: No, I never met him, but I knew of him, I heard his work.

ctx.x: A great theme. He was from a wealthy family as I recall.

Right. Ford Motor Company or one of those. He was from Detroit I know. He had automobile money behind him. Bob didn't live like a very rich man; I don't think he had his family's money while he was a band leader. He may have done that against the family wishes; maybe they chopped him off. I really don't know, but he was a nice guy, he was a very decent sort of person, easy going, gave nobody problems.
It was kind of a Glenn Miller band, wasn't it?
